name: Search existing transporter

structure.text: Columns: Name | Address | Country | Status | Approval Number | Type | View | Select. Row action buttons View and Select per row.

govukComponents.usage: Page H1 'Search for an existing transporter'
Wraps the three search inputs under a 'Search' legend
Name, Approval Number, Post Code search filters
Labels for the three search inputs
'Search' submit button (row View/Select buttons are also rendered but styled as link-buttons)
Traders search results table (Name, Address, Country, Status, Approval Number, Type, View, Select)
'Create a new transporter' link (id add-economic-operator) to /traders/transporter/new
Visible horizontal rule separating page regions
Screen-reader-only 'Traders search results table' caption, 'View' and 'Select' column header text, and the ':' separator in pagination

nonStandardPatterns.pattern: search-panel, traders-search-results, traders-search-results-form-desktop, traders-search-results-form-mobile, transporter-table-mobile, table-responsive, name-address-and-country, economic-operator-name, economic-operator-address, form-group
nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: IPAFFS-specific classes for the transporter/trader search widget: a search panel, one desktop results table plus 25 mobile-optimised result cards in the observed page (each reusing the govuk-table class on non-table markup), and cell-content grouping classes that stack name, address and country on mobile.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Bespoke responsive-table pattern with duplicated desktop/mobile markup and custom form-group wrappers. Not a Design System component; carries its own CSS. The rebuild should not copy this dual-table approach.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: GOV.UK Table (govuk-table) with responsive handling, or replace the whole search-and-select-from-a-long-list interaction with a simpler pattern (the 'Create a new transporter' path is the one exercised in the trace).

nonStandardPatterns.pattern: pagination, pagination-list, pagination-item, pagination-item-next, pagination-link, pagination-link-icon, pagination-link-label, pagination-link-title
nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Custom pagination control rendering 'Next page : 2 of 2032' with its own bespoke class set, not the Design System pagination component.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Reinvents a component that now exists in govuk-frontend. The '2 of 2032' page count implies the saved-transporter list is unbounded and paginated server-side — a heavy pattern for the rebuild.

nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Styles each per-row View and Select submit <button> to look like a link. The 'Create a new transporter' action is a separate plain govuk-link and does not use link-button.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: The row View/Select controls are true submit buttons but visually presented as links, which can obscure their action semantics.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: GOV.UK Button for true actions, or a plain govuk-link for navigation — choose based on semantics.

validationMessages.trigger: Submitting an empty search, a search with no matches, or invalid filter input
validationMessages.evidence: No trace captured an error/no-results state and no scoped CHED-P QA test performs a search. The page object exposes only 'Create a new transporter' (page-objects/notification/SearchExistingTransporterPage.ts:3-8), which the workflow follows immediately (workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:503-510).

openQuestions: Legacy validation confirms that all three transporter filters are optional and an empty search is allowed (traders/search.js:19-34); the former requiredness gap is resolved. Product policy should still decide whether returning the entire saved-transporter catalogue on an empty search is desirable in the rebuild.

This is a search-and-select-from-saved-transporters page. The trace and QA both exercise only the 'Create a new transporter' escape hatch (trace action 113; page-objects/notification/SearchExistingTransporterPage.ts:6-8; workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:503-510). The Search submit, per-row View, per-row Select, no-results state and pagination are not exercised by either source.

The results table shows a 'Status' column (all rows 'New') and a 'Type' column ('private transporter' / 'commercial transporter - user added'). The distinction between private vs commercial transporter and how it is set is not established from this page alone.

Pagination reports '2 of 2032' pages of saved/reference transporters — the source and scope of this list (address book, shared reference data, or seeded test data) is a gap; the rebuild must decide whether such a searchable saved-transporter store is a requirement at all.

No hint text and no validation messages were observed on this page (govuk-hint query returned none, no error summary in the captured snapshot). The QA page object also models none of the three search inputs or their results (page-objects/notification/SearchExistingTransporterPage.ts:3-8), so required-ness, matching semantics and exact validation/no-results copy remain gaps.
